entries.title: Efficient Caching Strategies for Edge-Rendered Web Applications
entries.abstract: We present a caching strategy for edge-rendered applications that reduces origin load by 40% while keeping content freshness within a configurable staleness bound. We evaluate the approach across three production workloads and discuss trade-offs against traditional CDN caching.

entries.title: A Comparative Study of Real-Time Collaboration Protocols
entries.abstract: This paper compares operational transformation and CRDT-based approaches for real-time collaborative editing under lossy network conditions, with a focus on convergence time and bandwidth overhead.
